description: Figure 2 illustrates the distribution of reasons for needing to scale non-deterministic problems. The chart consists of six slices representing different reasons. A light blue slice labeled “Foundation Models” occupies approximately 64% of the chart. A dark blue slice labeled “NPC Problems” occupies approximately 15%. A green slice labeled “Search” occupies approximately 10%. A purple slice labeled “Easy” occupies approximately 6%. A red slice labeled “Solve” occupies approximately 3%. Finally, a yellow slice labeled “Data” occupies approximately 2%. The chart includes a legend identifying each slice’s corresponding reason and color. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest proportion, moving clockwise around the circle. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice.
